answer: Because the timing is recorded against the horizon challenge, the wander audit can replay the sonnet history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 288 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. That bill is paid per identity, so 204 aliases cost 335 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
